verdict.rationale: Amplitude's docs describe releasing features behind a flag, ramping to an audience, and turning it off immediately. A quick-start guide, SDKs, and a management API support creating and controlling flags. Nothing evidences the speed-from-signup part of the story, and the data-model docs describe copying from a separate prod project, which suggests some setup friction. missing for 10: evidence of minutes-from-signup time-to-first-live-toggle, a documented free/self-serve signup path, independent hands-on corroboration of the setup speed

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Release behind a flag, ramp to the audience you choose, and turn it off the moment something looks wrong.
Use the Experiment management API to programmatically create and control flags and experiments.
Use Experiment SDKs to flag and test features across web, mobile, and backend.
